crosswalks.label: General and Operations Managers
crosswalks.rationale: General and Operations Managers is a bounded occupational baseline for Operations Manager; AXM profession identity/authority/maturity remain separate.

findings.summary: Operations Management must keep efficiency/capacity coordination separate from specialist quality, safety, policy and human-agency decisions.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make throughput-versus-quality, overload and delegated-authority boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Operations Manager reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent institutional authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No role label, package, model capability, repository permission or coordination function creates constitutional, product, professional or institutional authority.
